title: SF733 (2023-2024 Regular): Penalties increase for transferring certain firearms to persons who are ineligible to possess firearms

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (1st Engrossment, 2023-03-23; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/SF/733/versions/1/)

Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.7141, subd. 1): A person is guilty of a felony and may be sentenced to imprisonment for up to two years and to payment of a fine of not more than $10,000 if the person intentionally transfers a pistol or semiautomatic military-style assault weapon to another and the person knows that the transferee:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.7141, subd. 2): A person who violates this section may be sentenced to imprisonment for up to seven years and to payment of a fine of not more than $20,000 if the transferee possesses or uses the weapon within one year after the transfer in furtherance of a felony crime of violence.
